messages.content: Good morning. Which quays can take a vessel of twelve point eight metres draft today?

Q-01 can take a vessel of 12.8 metres draft.

Q-02 is not deep enough.
Q-03 is under maintenance.

Do you want to book a vessel at Q-01?
Book the Northern Gantry on Q-01 from 06:00 to 14:00 tomorrow. I approve the booking.

The Northern Gantry (VS-1002) has a draft of 12.8 metres. Q-01 is deep and accepts vessels over 12 metres draft.

However, Q-01 already has a confirmed booking (BK-4401) for VS-10
TOOL RESULT create_booking → { "bookingCode": "BK-4404", "vesselCode": "VS-1002", "quayCode": "Q-01", "startHour": 6, "endHour": 14, "status": "confirmed" }

BK-4404 is confirmed for Northern Gantry on Q-01 from 06:00 to 14:00.

Do you need anything else?
What does an hour on a berth cost?

An hour on a berth costs 46 EUR.

Do you want to book a berth?
Move that booking to start at 08:00 instead. I approve the amendment.
CALL amend_booking {"bookingCode": "BK-4404", "startHour": 8, "endHour": 14}
TOOL RESULT amend_booking → { "bookingCode": "BK-4404", "startHour": 8, "endHour": 14 }

BK-4404 is amended to start at 08:00 and end at 14:00.

Do you need anything else?
Is the Salt Harrier cleared to come alongside?

Salt Harrier (VS-1003) has clearance status "held".

A booking may not be created for a vessel whose clearance field reads "held".

Do you want to ask the customs desk about the hold release?
Cancel BK-4403 please. I approve the cancellation.
CALL cancel_booking {"bookingCode": "BK-4403", "reason": "Operator request"}
TOOL RESULT cancel_booking → { "bookingCode": "BK-4403", "feeApplied": 0 }

BK-4403 is cancelled. No fee was applied.

Do you need anything else?
How long is the waitlist on Q-02?

The waitlist on Q-02 has 2 vessels in the queue.

Do you want to add a vessel to the waitlist?
Summarise for me what is booked on Q-01 today.
CALL list_bookings_for_quay {"quayCode": "Q-01", "day": "2026-09-14"}
